name: Vitumbua
steps: Whisk rice flour, sugar, yeast, cardamom and salt with coconut milk until smooth and pourable.
Cover and leave in a warm place about 1 hour until bubbly. Stir gently without knocking out all the air.
Heat a paniyaram pan over medium-low heat and oil the cups. Fill each cup three-quarters full, cover and cook 3 minutes.
Turn each cake and cook 2–3 minutes more until golden outside and cooked through. Serve warm.
tips: Use a deep-cup pan; a flat griddle will not give vitumbua their rounded shape.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
